title: Per-Bill Authorizations for Ancillary Charges on Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
## The authorization

A per-bill authorization lets Keystone Ridge pay one named ancillary charge from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, up to a stated amount. A per-bill authorization for an ancillary charge names a charge on the resident's Ancillary and Optional Services Billing account and states the amount the account will pay toward it; the business office posts the transfer on the second business day after the authorization is signed, so signing it moves no money that day.

## When the amount is fixed

The amount a new per-bill authorization covers is fixed only after the account's ledger carries a payer-covered return for the most recent transfer to an ancillary charge, where part of that transfer paid for days a payer covers.

Put the other way round: while part of the most recent transfer to an ancillary charge paid for days a payer covers and the account's ledger carries no payer-covered return for that transfer, the amount of a new per-bill authorization is not yet fixed.

## Signing: `sign_bill_payment_authorization_74e4ddf9`

This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it and hand it over; the customer themselves signs it: the resident, an agent under the resident's power of attorney, or the court-appointed guardian of the estate. Signing records the authorization on the account's list of signed requests, naming the charge, the kind of center bill it belongs to, who signed and the amount authorized. No money moves when it is signed and the account balance is unchanged.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trust_account_id` | the resident funds account the charge is to be paid from, as shown on the account record | identifier |
| `bill_category` | the kind of center bill the named charge belongs to | one of the five values below |
| `bill_entry_id` | the one center charge being authorized, as shown on that charge's line in the ledger of the billing account it sits on | identifier |
| `requested_by` | who signs the authorization | one of the three values below |
| `amount` | the most the account is authorized to pay toward the named charge | US dollars, a decimal number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

Values of `bill_category`: `medicaid_patient_pay` (a monthly Medical Assistance patient pay charge); `private_room_board` (a monthly private-pay room and board charge); `bed_hold` (a charge for nights a bed was held while the resident was away); `ancillary_charge` (a charge on the resident's ancillary and optional services account); `medicare_coinsurance` (a Medicare Part A skilled nursing coinsurance charge).

Values of `requested_by`: `resident` (the resident signs personally); `power_of_attorney` (an agent under the resident's power of attorney signs); `guardian` (the court-appointed guardian of the resident's estate signs).

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Authorization <request id> signed by <signer> on account <account> for <bill category> charge <charge>: up to <amount> USD." The presence of the authorization's reference number shows that it was recorded.
